'''TM-82''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]] it was posted at the [[Outpost Overseer]] on [[Voss]], where the droid asked an Imperial for assistance.<ref name="TOR" />
